skill_name: Create an argument in favor of homeschooling.
workflow: Homeschooling allows children to learn in an environment that is tailored to their individual needs, allowing parents and guardians to give their children the best education possible. Homeschooling allows for flexibility and creativity, which result in a more in-depth understanding of concepts, as well as providing access to a variety of resources that may not be available in a traditional school. Furthermore, homeschooling allows parents to choose the material their children will learn based on
